label: digit 3 input at positions 4-7 in a sequence starting with b
explanation: Very sparse feature. It fires almost only when the digit 3 is input during the original phase at positions 4-7 (97% of mass is on in_tok=3, peaking at orig_idx 5-6), and mostly when the first original token is b (84% of mass; first_tok=w is a weak second at 6%). It never fires at t<4, never on copy-phase steps, and only negligibly on <DEL>. Precision is low: most qualifying b...3 steps stay silent. Which ones fire depends on the tokens before the 3 in a way spread across many tokens (prev_tok q/f/c and prev2_tok f/r/n raise the rate; having seen two or more of f,q,r,n,c,l,x,p,... improves F1 to about 0.41). No simple rule pins it down. The largest activations come on b ... f q 3 / b ... q 3 contexts.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=b (+5.09), orig1=w (+2.51), prev_tok=q (+2.12), phase=0 & in_tok=3 (+1.88), recall_idx=-1 & in_tok=3 (+1.88), orig2=r (+1.78). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-2.24), orig_idx=-1 (-1.79), orig5=- (-1.71), t=3 (-1.42).
